entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A human shieldmage (geometrist) and former planeswalker from Gobakhan whose magic manifests as geometric shields of white light.

entities.name: Echoverse Teyo Verada
entities.description: An Echoverse version of Teyo who harnessed the diamondstorms and became Gobakhan's best diamondblade assassin; his spark never ignited.

entities.name: Gobakhan
entities.description: Teyo's home plane, a desert world of diamondstorms.

entities.name: Abbot Barrez
entities.description: Found young Teyo in the wreckage of his village and tried to train him in orthodox geometry.

entities.name: Order of the Shieldmage
entities.description: The order of shieldmages on Gobakhan in which Teyo was the worst acolyte.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who guided Teyo and considers him naive but with hidden strength.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A Gateless street urchin who guided Teyo on Ravnica and became his friend.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who explained planeswalking to Teyo.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose invasion of Ravnica trapped the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane to which the Interplanar Beacon called Teyo.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild ruled by a triumvirate that Kaya rallied against Bolas.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: Giant chief enforcer of the Orzhov Syndicate who convinced the triumvirate to fight.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Golgari leader who pledged the Swarm to the fight against Bolas.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: Rakdos emissary resurrected as a blood witch, who led the Rakdos against Bolas.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon resurrected and granted the Living Guildpact power.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God-Eternal who attacked the ritual and was incinerated by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker Kaya was assigned to track and kill; she later takes the name Ana Iora on Fiora.

entities.name: Zahid
entities.description: A djinn bound to a blue sapphire amulet that gave the fake Liliana her power.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Liliana's artifact, used to subdue Zahid and later delivered as proof of her death.

entities.name: Spark Rupture
entities.description: The event after the invasion in which Teyo lost his spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

events.summary: Teyo's powers first manifest at age four when a diamondstorm kills his parents and sister; Abbot Barrez finds him.
events.quote: when his parents and his sister were killed in a diamondstorm

events.summary: Teyo becomes the worst acolyte in the Order of the Shieldmage under orthodox training.
events.quote: Teyo became the worst acolyte in the Order of the Shieldmage

events.summary: Teyo's spark ignites and he planeswalks to Ravnica, called by the Interplanar Beacon, escaping suffocation in the sand.
Teyo wanders Ravnica, guided by Rat, and is joined by Kaya and Ral Zarek, who explain he is a planeswalker.
events.quote: who explained to him that he was a planeswalker

events.summary: Bolas's invasion begins; Teyo uses his shields to protect allies and hinder Eternals.
events.quote: he used his shields to protect his allies and hinder Eternals

events.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat rally the Orzhov Syndicate after Bilagru convinces the triumvirate.
events.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

events.summary: Vraska returns, unites the Golgari and pledges them to the fight against Bolas.
events.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas

events.summary: Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
events.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

events.summary: During the Guildpact Chamber ritual Teyo shields against Kefnet twice, and Niv-Mizzet, resurrected, incinerates Kefnet.
events.quote: Teyo managed to create a mighty shield to stop the God-Eternal twice

events.summary: Teyo chooses to remain on Ravnica after the Immortal Sun is disabled and survives the battle.
events.quote: He survived the battle and was present during the Planewide Celebration

events.summary: Kaya takes Teyo and Rat to Gobakhan; Teyo finds his powers far outshine the monks and leaves again.
events.quote: Teyo discovered that his powers now far outshone those of his fellow monks and acolytes

events.summary: On Dominaria Teyo frees Liliana from her trance and deduces that the fake Liliana draws power from a bound djinn.
events.quote: Teyo attempted to remove the gold collar from Liliana's neck, which jolted her back to her senses

events.summary: Rat destroys the amulet freeing Zahid, who tries to kill Teyo; Liliana subdues Zahid with the Chain Veil.
events.quote: Liliana then used the Chain Veil to subdue Zahid and save Teyo.

events.summary: Liliana is allowed to live; Teyo transports the Veil to Ravnica as proof of her death, and Niv-Mizzet locks it in a puzzle box.
events.quote: Liliana was allowed to live, although proof of a kill would be needed.

events.summary: Teyo travels with Kaya and Rat to Fiora to join Liliana, now called Ana Iora, on her path to redemption.
events.quote: Liliana, who had changed her name to Ana Iora

events.summary: Teyo loses his spark in the Spark Rupture and returns to Gobakhan to protect his home.
events.quote: Teyo lost his spark in the Spark Rupture

relations.note: Took him in and tried to train him.
relations.quote: After Barrez took him and tried to train him in orthodox geometry
Teyo became the worst acolyte in the Order of the Shieldmage

relations.note: Formed a deep connection with her and Rat.
relations.quote: Having formed a deep connection with both Kaya and Rat

relations.note: He developed a crush on Rat during the War.
relations.quote: he developed a crush on Rat
acted as Teyo's guide to the plane

relations.note: Zahid tried to kill Teyo, who was containing it.

relations.quote: Born in a tiny Gobakhan village
